units.title: Ceiling Hoist / Portable Hoist and transfer procedures
units.summary: Ceiling Hoist / Portable Hoist A hoist is a mechanical lift or hydraulic • lift, that can be free standing or attached to a ceiling Used to move patients ✓who cannot bear weight ✓who are unpredictable or unreliable ✓who have a medical condition that does not allow them to stand or assist with moving ✓e.g., Spinal Cord Injury (lower limbs paralyzed, tetraplegia) Ceiling Hoist / Mobile Hoist Important notes Assessed and assigned by ➢ physiotherapists No hip and pelvic fracture or ➢ problems Must operated by 2 people(1 x main operation of the hoist, 1 x supervision of patient) Key Steps A A ❖ Environment and hoist preparation B B ❖ Patient postural preparation C C ❖ Move the patient • Moved from the original location to another • place, usually • Bed to wheelchair or • Wheelchair to bed D D Resume patient in comfortable &supported position A Environment and hoist preparation Preparation in advance Check if the transfer machine is operating normally? Are the batteries installed and charged?

units.title: Hospital Bed / Ripple Bed
units.summary: Hospital bed Safe & protect both caregivers & disabled individuals. Easier for Caregivers/ carers on home care for their disabled members esp transfer. Prolonged home care instead of institutional care. Ripple Bed Aim minimize risk of pressure sore reduce pressure between patient's skin and support • medium distribute weight across a large contact area • Target: individuals who are dependent on bed/ wheelchair for a long period.

units.title: Rehab equipment for activities of daily living (ADL)
units.summary: Rehab equipment for ADL Commode act as mobile toilet for those with disability/ illness situations, who need assistance in toileting easier transport for caregiver on bathing task • Support on Body parts Shoulder Sling/Arm Sling Protect arm after injury to shoulder/ elbow. Facilitate healing since keep position + avoid movements After shoulder operation eg rotator cuff After stroke to prevent subluxation • Carpal Tunnel Wrist Brace Aim stabilize wrist in “Neutral” position so to minimize pressure on the median nerve “rest” from movements reduce pain & numbness at affected palm & fingers could wear during sleep • Back Brace Add “Stability” with better awareness on the posture.
